const s=ctx.state,gl=ctx.gl;s.canvas=new OffscreenCanvas(1,1);s.c=s.canvas.getContext('2d');s.texture=gl.createTexture();s.program=ctx.utils.createProgram(ctx.utils.FULLSCREEN_VERTEX_SHADER,`#version 300 es
precision highp float;in vec2 v_uv;out vec4 outColor;uniform sampler2D u_image;void main(){outColor=texture(u_image,vec2(v_uv.x,1.-v_uv.y));}`);s.mount=()=>{const div=document.createElement('div');div.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-10000px;top:0;width:512px;height:512px;overflow:hidden';document.body.appendChild(div);return div;};s.colors=['#57d8c6','#ffbc78','#ad9bff'];const mod=await ctx.utils.import('https://esm.sh/canvas-sketch@0.7.8?bundle');s.surface=document.createElement('canvas');s.manager=await (mod.default??mod)(()=>({context:c,width:w,height:h})=>{const u=ctx.uniforms;c.fillStyle='#0b1625';c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);c.save();c.translate(w/2,h/2);for(let layer=0;layer<5;layer++){c.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<=720;i++){const a=i/720*Math.PI*2,r=(.17+layer*.043)*w*(1+.34*Math.cos(a*u.u_petals+u.u_phase));const x=Math.cos(a)*r,y=Math.sin(a)*r;i?c.lineTo(x,y):c.moveTo(x,y);}c.strokeStyle=s.colors[layer%3];c.lineWidth=2;c.stroke();}c.restore();},{canvas:s.surface,parent:false,dimensions:[512,512],pixelRatio:1,animate:false,hotkeys:false,scaleToView:false});
